description: Microsoft US Building Footprints is a country-wide set of 129,591,852 computer-generated building footprint polygons for the 50 United States and the District of Columbia, derived from satellite imagery by Microsoft's computer-vision algorithms. Microsoft Maps released it to support the OpenStreetMap ecosystem. Coverage is national; 73,250,745 footprints inside a focal area come from imagery of 2019 and 2020, while the rest were extracted from older imagery averaging about 2012, and each footprint carries a capture-date tag where the vintage could be deduced. Access: GeoJSON files per state, linked from the repository. Licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL), free. Caveats: this is an older release; Microsoft's Global ML Building Footprints dataset now covers the United States with more recent imagery and height estimates, and footprints are machine-detected with local errors. Simulation uses are building exposure inventories for hazard and resilience studies in the United States. Related records: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (successor), FEMA USA Structures and the USACE National Structure Inventory, which build on footprint data.
name: Microsoft US Building Footprints
notes: Maturity set to archived because the global dataset supersedes it; the README states no end of maintenance, so this is a judgement recorded here. GitHub web pages and API are blocked in this environment; repository facts were read through raw.githubusercontent.com and git (ls-remote, shallow fetch of the tag for its commit date).
